findings.title: Obfuscated or dynamically constructed code is executed
findings.message: eval executes dynamically built code
findings.evidence: eval "$SHELL_RELOAD_CMD" 2>/dev/null
findings.remediation: Replace encoded payloads with plain, reviewable source. Avoid eval; use arrays and functions instead.

findings.title: Code is obtained from a mutable remote reference and built or installed
findings.message: git clone of a mutable reference (found in documentation: this is what users are told to run)
findings.evidence: git clone https://github.com/gmaxxxie/Scene-Switcher.git
findings.remediation: Pin to a full 40-character commit (git checkout <sha>, cargo --rev <sha>, go @<version>, pip @<sha>) or to a signed release.
